label: fir, beech, birch, oak, maple · spacing 3 m · target height 15 m · twig density 50 % · foliation 34 %
subtitle: 11 models · 1.0 of 1.8 M points
description: A synthetic stand of 5 trees (fir, beech, birch, oak, maple) with a target height of 15 m, generated with The Grove and virtually laser-scanned with HELIOS++ matched to the ECOSENSE acquisition. A test stand of the training set (51 stands, foliation ≤ 75 %): the models shown were not trained on it.

frame.description: Local frame of the synthetic stand in meters, without a geographic reference: x and y horizontal with the origin at the stand center, z = height above the flat virtual ground (z = 0). Returns below 1 m are removed (ground removal), and the LAI labels exclude the leaf area below 1 m.

layers.label: LAI label
layers.notes: Exact partial LAI of the leaf meshes: one-sided leaf area per 2 m × 2 m prediction column and 2 m height bin, divided by 4 m²; leaf area below 1 m excluded, as in the training labels.

layers.label: Feature-MLP
layers.notes: Trained on the training partition of the training set (51 stands, foliation ≤ 75 %) with the height shift of the tallest stands (labels up to 44–46 m). LAI cap: no LAI above the highest height bin of the prediction column with at least three returns. The total LAI of a prediction column is the sum of its profile.

layers.label: Random Forest
layers.notes: Trained on the training partition of the training set (51 stands, foliation ≤ 75 %) with the height shift of the tallest stands (labels up to 44–46 m). LAI cap: no LAI above the highest height bin of the prediction column with at least three returns. The Random Forest consists of two models, one for the total LAI and one for the profile; the profile is rescaled to the total LAI of each prediction column (all zeros where it sums to 0).
